# Garden plan

The plot behind the shed gets sun from mid morning until late afternoon. Beds one to three face south.

## Spring

### When to plant

Start the tomatoes indoors six weeks before the last frost, then move them out once the nights stay above ten degrees. Peas and broad beans can go straight into the ground in March.

### What to buy

- Two bags of peat-free compost
- Seed potatoes, a first early and a maincrop
- Netting for the brassicas

## Summer

### Watering

Water deeply twice a week rather than a little every day. See [[Watering schedule]] for the rota.

### Pests

Slugs go for the lettuce first. Copper tape around the raised beds helps, and a beer trap catches the rest.

## Autumn

Lift the maincrop potatoes after the leaves die back. Sow green manure on any bed that will sit empty over winter.
